summary: Evidence-gated concept risk register. Scores describe current uncertainty, not predicted harm.

dimensions.label: 临时几何
dimensions.note: Official boundaries and the Dazhongsi anchor remain unavailable.
dimensions.mitigation: Keep low-confidence labels visible and recalculate the full package on official polygons.
dimensions.human_review: Licensed planning review and organiser geometry confirmation before professional scoring.

dimensions.label: 隐私与歧视
dimensions.note: Public AI services could create surveillance or discriminatory access.
dimensions.mitigation: Ban resident scores, default enrolment and face-based access; retain appeal and a human alternative.
dimensions.human_review: Public-interest, legal and accessibility review before any G2 public trial.

dimensions.label: 技术成熟度
dimensions.note: A polished prototype can be mistaken for dependable urban infrastructure.
dimensions.mitigation: Do not advance beyond G1 without an operator, baseline, benefit, residual and exit evidence.
dimensions.human_review: Independent safety and accountable-operator review at every evidence gate.

dimensions.label: 数字排斥
dimensions.note: Screen-only services can exclude people and fail during outages.
dimensions.mitigation: Retain printed, telephone, on-site human and accessible alternatives.
dimensions.human_review: Accessibility advocates and affected users review the service before public trial.

dimensions.label: 市政实施
dimensions.note: Power, fire, heat, noise, drainage and cyber capacity are unverified.
dimensions.mitigation: Block deployment until capacity and discipline-specific reviews are complete.
dimensions.human_review: Fire, energy, municipal, structural and cybersecurity professionals sign off before deployment.

dimensions.label: 更新挤出
dimensions.note: Permanent renewal can displace everyday services and small operators.
dimensions.mitigation: Use reversible trials and publish distributional-impact review before permanent works.
dimensions.human_review: Residents and small businesses review distributional impacts before permanent works.
